intent.rationale: Generated combinational processes drive each trim-array entry without any clocked write port.

labels.note: Memory trim is written by non-clocked always_comb processes (one per generate lane).
The memory elements are written by non-clocked combinational processes.

rationale: Generated combinational processes drive each trim-array entry without any clocked write port.

adjudication.reason: Elaboration creates four unconditional combinational assignments, each to a distinct complete trim element. The processes do not overlap, every word always equals a & b, and the dynamic read is a combinational selection with no retained state; several processes writing disjoint elements are not several writers of the same storage. As a hardware-defect class, LC20 does not make this wire bundle into defective memory merely because it uses an unpacked array. An independent Icarus simulation passed all 262144 two-state combinations of a, b and addr; complete, disjoint assignments establish the absence of storage and driver conflict. The final label is good LC20, with no defect sites and critical false.
